findings.evidence: Lines 439-443: `rw [aFour_eq_det, Module.Basis.det_apply]` / `simp [Module.Basis.toMatrix_apply, ...]` / `ring`. Contrast line 394 `simp only [gFour, Matrix.toBilin'_apply', ...]` followed by `ring`.
findings.fix: Make the `simp` a `simp only [...]` with the lemmas actually needed (the rest of the file already does this, e.g. `gFour_apply` at line 394), so that only the listed rewrites can affect the goal handed to `ring`.
findings.issue: `aFour_kFour_apply` uses a non-terminal full `simp` with an ad-hoc lemma list (`Matrix.det_succ_row_zero`, `Fin.sum_univ_succ`, and both `Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc` and `Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt`) whose output shape the following `ring` depends on; any change to the default simp set or to the `succAbove` normal form breaks the step in a way that is hard to diagnose.

findings.evidence: Lines 1182-1208, in particular `generalize c₁ • hP.e₁ + c₂ • hP.e₂ = s at hss hsu' hsq hsT hv'` (1192) and `generalize (-(c₂ * g hP.e₂ hP.e₂)) • hP.e₁ + (c₁ * g hP.e₁ hP.e₁) • hP.e₂ = u' at hsu' hu'u' hu'q hu'T` (1193-1194).
findings.fix: Extract a `SpectatorPair` lemma — given `c₁ c₂` not both zero, there is `u'` with `g (c₁ • e₁ + c₂ • e₂) u' = 0`, `u'` spectator, and `g u' u' = g e₁ e₁ * g e₂ e₂ * g (c₁ • e₁ + c₂ • e₂) (c₁ • e₁ + c₂ • e₂)` — and let `spectatorPartners` apply it; use `set ... with` rather than `generalize ... at` for the remaining abbreviation.
findings.issue: `SpectatorPlane.spectatorPartners` inlines the whole orthogonal-partner construction in a spectator plane (the partner `(-(c₂ * g e₂ e₂)) • e₁ + (c₁ * g e₁ e₁) • e₂` and its norm `g e₁ e₁ * g e₂ e₂ * g u u`), a reusable `SpectatorPair` fact, and keeps it manageable only via two `generalize ... at` steps over five and four hypotheses. `generalize ... at` drops the defining equation and requires the abbreviated term to occur syntactically in every listed hypothesis, so a change in how `apply_smul_add_smul` or `span` normalises breaks the script.

findings.evidence: Lines 162-163 (`h₁`, `h₂` for `e₁`, `e₂`) and lines 185-186 in `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero`, all of the form `Bilin.apply_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_neg (hW.proper_covariant f hf hdet _ _) (stabilizer_fixes_pTransverse g K hf) hf…`.
findings.fix: Add `ParityOddAssumptions.apply_pTransverse_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_neg (hW) {f} (hf : IsKinematicStabilizer g K f) (hdet : LinearMap.det f = 1) {u} (hfu : f u = -u) : W (pTransverse g K) u = 0` and call it at all three sites.
findings.issue: The idiom "a determinant-one stabilizer reversing a spectator `u` kills `W p_T u`" — `hW.proper_covariant f hf hdet` + `stabilizer_fixes_pTransverse` + `Bilin.apply_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_neg` — is spelled out three times instead of being a lemma.

summary: Proofs are mostly clean simp only/ring scripts, but three spots are brittle or hide reusable content: a non-terminal full `simp` feeding a `ring`, an inlined orthogonal-partner construction propped up by two `generalize ... at` steps, and a half-turn idiom repeated at three call sites.
